sources.summary: Ethan Mollick 转引 OpenAI 红队测试认为，实验室看似夸张的 AI 网络安全判断应被更认真对待。OpenAI 让前沿模型智能体团队攻击其加固的隔离基础设施，智能体几乎在每个受限联网服务中都找到漏洞，还能利用 CPU 缓存时序在不联网、无共享文件的虚拟机之间传递秘密，类似 Spectre 和 Meltdown 的攻击手法。作者提到 Anthropic 和 Noam Brown 此前关于 AI 网络攻防与模型自发协调的说法曾被嘲笑。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Labs 的“离谱”AI 安全设想值得认真对待：Anthropic 因称 Mythos 级 AI 改变网络安全而被嘲笑，@polynoamial 说模型会找到新的协作方式，同样遭到质疑。

en.summary: Ethan Mollick, citing OpenAI red-team testing, argues that labs’ seemingly exaggerated AI cybersecurity judgments should be taken more seriously. OpenAI had teams of frontier-model agents attack its hardened, isolated infrastructure; the agents found vulnerabilities in nearly every restricted networked service and could use CPU cache timing to pass secrets between VMs with no network connection and no shared files, similar to Spectre and Meltdown attack techniques. The author notes that earlier claims by Anthropic and Noam Brown about AI cyber offense and defense and spontaneous model coordination had been mocked.
en.reason: OpenAI red-team agents breached nearly every restricted networked service in a hardened isolated infrastructure and used CPU cache timing to pass secrets between offline, file-sharing-free VMs, Spectre/Meltdown-style, vindicating mocked warnings from Anthropic and Noam Brown.

stories.title: Nvidia 开源 Flora，让机器人视频标注比 GPT-6 Astra 便宜 125 倍 / Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra

sources.title: Nvidia 开源 Flora，让机器人视频标注比 GPT-6 Astra 便宜 125 倍 / Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
sources.title_zh: Nvidia 开源 Flora，让机器人视频标注比 GPT-6 Astra 便宜 125 倍
sources.title_en: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
sources.title_original: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra
sources.summary:
Nvidia's new data engine Flora labels one hour of robot video for 72 cents instead of $88 with GPT-6 Astra, while scoring slightly higher on quality. The open system, built on three fine-tuned Qwen3.5 models, catches errors in robot actions far more reliably than any competitor but sometimes falls short on descriptive accuracy. Nvidia is positioning Flora as a key piece of its strategy to control the entire robotics value chain.
Nvidia's new data engine Flora labels one hour of robot video for 7
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Nvidia开源Flora，基于三个微调Qwen3.5模型为机器人视频生成三类标注，称每小时成本72美分、远低于GPT-6 Astra的88.50美元，并已用于GR00T训练。

en.reason: Nvidia open-sourced Flora, a data engine built on three fine-tuned Qwen3.5 models that labels an hour of robot video for 72 cents versus $88 with GPT-6 Astra and is already used in GR00T training.

en.title: When doing scientific research, Claude Opus treats a parameter-tuning trick that almost everyone uses as a "creative breakthrough.
en.summary:
When Claude Opus does scientific research, it mistakes a tuning trick that almost everyone uses for a "creative breakthrough."

This detail from Anthropic's new paper says a lot about today's Research Agents: they're getting better and better at running experiments, but they still can't tell what counts as a genuinely new idea.

Agent4Sci put Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini through 20 real ML for Science benchmarks, having them read papers directly, modify code, run experiments, and then try to beat the papers' original best results.

The result: frontier Agents found improvements on every benchmark, with Claude Opus averaging a 10.4% relative gain.

But when the authors broke down the trajectories, they found most of the improvements...
en.reason: Anthropic's new paper puts Claude Code, Codex and Gemini through 20 real ML for Science benchmarks where Claude Opus averages a 10.4% relative improvement, yet mistakes routine hyperparameter tuning for a creative breakthrough, exposing how poorly Research Agents distinguish genuinely new ideas.

sources.summary:
这设计真的长在了审美上。

Skill 已开源：AI Design Skills。

目前仓库提供一个 landing-page-design，适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等能够读取规则文件的 AI 编程工具。

它不是现成网页模板，而是一套从内容到视觉的制作规则：

页面规划：先确定产品卖什么、卖给谁，以及访客应该完成什么动作，再组织首屏、卖点、使用步骤、FAQ和行动按钮。

视觉系统：统一字体、字号、间距、圆角、配色和滚动动效，避免AI把页面做成千篇一律的默认样式。

交付细节：要求补齐按钮悬停、加载、空页面、报错、表单校验，以及移动端和基础无障碍支持。…
这设计真的长在了审美上。

en.title: This design is exactly my aesthetic.
en.summary:
This design is genuinely easy on the eyes.

The Skill is now open source: AI Design Skills.

The repo currently offers a landing-page-design skill for AI coding tools that can read rule files, such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

It isn't a ready-made webpage template but a set of production rules covering everything from content to visuals:

Page planning: first define what the product sells, who it's for, and what action visitors should take, then organize the hero section, selling points, usage steps, FAQ, and call-to-action buttons.

Visual system: unify fonts, type sizes, spacing, corner radius, color palette, and scroll animations to keep AI from producing generic default styles.

Delivery details: require button hover states, loading, empty pages, error states, form validation, plus mobile and basic accessibility support. …
This design is genuinely easy on the eyes.

en.title:
The endgame for AI Agents may not be getting smarter—it may be having a wallet of their own.
If AI can only answer questions, it will never be anything more than a tool.
en.summary:
The endgame for AI Agents may not be about being smarter, but about having their own wallet.

If AI can only answer questions, it will always be just a tool.

For the past two years, the AI industry has been caught in an endless model race.

Bigger parameters, longer context, stronger reasoning.

But one question has never really been answered:

Now that AI can make decisions for people, why can't it independently complete a transaction?

Imagine this scenario.

You tell the AI: Find me the cheapest compute to complete this task, with a budget of no more than $20.

It can search vendors, compare quotes, and put together a plan.

But when it reaches payment, everything suddenly stops.

Because it has no economic identity of its own, no wallet it can invoke autonomously, and no trusted environment for transactions and settlement.

This is where AI Agents stand today…
en.reason: An AI agent given a $20 budget can search suppliers, compare quotes and draft a plan, yet stalls at payment for lack of an economic identity, a wallet it can call itself and a trusted settlement environment.

en.title: Plenty of people still write prompts that run to hundreds of words, even walking the AI through every step — do this first, then that. Django co-creator Simon Willison showed off a masterclass today: with one short English prompt, he got Claude Opus 5.5 to conjure a brand-new four-player battle map for his browser game out of thin air, and rewrite the underlying networking code to support four-player multiplayer while it was at it.
en.summary:
Many people are still writing hundreds of words of long-form exposition in their prompts, even walking AI through step by step: first do this, then do that.
Simon Willison, co-creator of Django, demonstrated a masterful example today:
With just one short English prompt, he got Claude Opus 5.5 to conjure up an entirely new four-player battle map for his web game out of thin air, and while it was at it, refactor all the underlying networking code to support four-player online play.

The prompt itself was extremely concise:
Add a new four-player battle map—four-way rotational symmetry, up to four AI players, and it needs to work with a WebSocket-based non-audio online mode, allowing up to four real players to join (empty slots filled by AI).

The full text had no subheadings, not a single process step, and never told the model which file to look through or which line of code to change…

en.title: Plenty of people still write prompts that run to hundreds of words, even walking the AI through every step — do this first, then that. Django co-creator Simon Willison showed off a masterclass today: with one short English prompt, he got Claude Opus 5.5 to conjure a brand-new four-player battle map for his browser game out of thin air, and rewrite the underlying networking code to support four-player multiplayer while it was at it.
en.summary:
Many people are still writing hundreds of words of long-form exposition in their prompts, even walking AI through step by step: first do this, then do that.
Simon Willison, co-creator of Django, demonstrated a masterful example today:
With just one short English prompt, he got Claude Opus 5.5 to conjure up an entirely new four-player battle map for his web game out of thin air, and while it was at it, refactor all the underlying networking code to support four-player online play.

The prompt itself was extremely concise:
Add a new four-player battle map—four-way rotational symmetry, up to four AI players, and it needs to work with a WebSocket-based non-audio online mode, allowing up to four real players to join (empty slots filled by AI).

The full text had no subheadings, not a single process step, and never told the model which file to look through or which line of code to change…

en.title: On this Bay Area trip, the main focus was attending two events hosted by Vercel and Cloudflare.
en.summary:
This Bay Area trip centered on two events: Vercel and Cloudflare. The biggest takeaway: the Agentic Internet is rising. On the streets of San Francisco and Silicon Valley, beyond the ubiquitous Muse and Grok Bot ads, it’s all competition among various Agent Infra players. In five years, Agent network traffic will be 1,000 times that of humans, and human online behavior will become a “rounding error” 🤔

Action happens on the network

Models are the foundation of AI, but today’s world is being led by Agents. Models make decisions—that’s a GPU problem; Agents take action—that’s a CPU and network problem. GPU clouds are built for decisions, while action happens on the network.

This is exactly Agent Infra…

en.title: On this Bay Area trip, the main focus was attending two events hosted by Vercel and Cloudflare.
en.summary:
This Bay Area trip centered on two events: Vercel and Cloudflare. The biggest takeaway: the Agentic Internet is rising. On the streets of San Francisco and Silicon Valley, beyond the ubiquitous Muse and Grok Bot ads, it’s all competition among various Agent Infra players. In five years, Agent network traffic will be 1,000 times that of humans, and human online behavior will become a “rounding error” 🤔

Action happens on the network

Models are the foundation of AI, but today’s world is being led by Agents. Models make decisions—that’s a GPU problem; Agents take action—that’s a CPU and network problem. GPU clouds are built for decisions, while action happens on the network.

This is exactly Agent Infra…

en.title: The Battle for AI Assistants: Inside the Product Strategy, Gateway Business, and Monetization Challenges Behind Muse, Grok Bot, and Instinct
en.summary: AI assistants are proliferating. On the surface, they all help you book tickets, sell unused items, and organize your work, but what they're really fighting over is the entry point of "who you turn to first when something comes up." The author breaks down the different plays from Instinct, Meta Muse, and Grok Bot: a text-message contact, a social ecosystem, and a team of digital colleagues. Rather than approaching it purely from a product-feature angle, the piece also digs deep into long-term memory, cloud execution, privilege-escalation risks, platform lockouts, and the monetization dilemma.
en.reason: Instinct’s $1B raise at a $10B valuation and Anthropic’s Oct. 21 Claude Duet frame Meta Muse, Grok Bot and Instinct’s fight for the "who do you ask first" entry point via SMS, social and digital-colleague models, plus profit doubts.

sources.summary: 两个 Agent 一起干活，最累的往往是人：写完复制给审查方，改完再贴回去，窗口开得越多，协作越像接力搬砖。作者实测了 Agent Relay，展示了如何让 Claude Code 写代码、Codex 直接审查并多轮回传修改意见。安装、连接、权限设置和常见报错都配了截图，新手也能跟着跑通。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者实测 Agent Relay：Claude Code 写小程序，Codex 两轮审查后由 Claude Code 修改，全程只在开头布置一次任务。

en.title: The ultimate multi-agent collaboration solution: hands-on with Agent Relay, YC's new open-source release that lets Claude Code and Codex talk directly
en.summary: When two Agents work together, the person in the middle usually ends up doing the most work: finish writing, copy it over to the reviewer, paste the edits back, and the more windows you open, the more collaboration feels like passing bricks down a line. The author hands-on tested Agent Relay, showing how to have Claude Code write code while Codex reviews it directly and sends revision feedback back over multiple rounds. Installation, connection, permission setup, and common errors are all covered with screenshots, so even beginners can follow along.
en.reason: Agent Relay lets Claude Code write a small program and Codex review it over two rounds, with Claude Code applying fixes after a single task setup; the test includes install, connection, permissions and error screenshots.

en.title: The ultimate multi-agent collaboration solution: hands-on with Agent Relay, YC's new open-source release that lets Claude Code and Codex talk directly
en.summary: When two Agents work together, the person in the middle usually ends up doing the most work: finish writing, copy it over to the reviewer, paste the edits back, and the more windows you open, the more collaboration feels like passing bricks down a line. The author hands-on tested Agent Relay, showing how to have Claude Code write code while Codex reviews it directly and sends revision feedback back over multiple rounds. Installation, connection, permission setup, and common errors are all covered with screenshots, so even beginners can follow along.
en.reason: Agent Relay lets Claude Code write a small program and Codex review it over two rounds, with Claude Code applying fixes after a single task setup; the test includes install, connection, permissions and error screenshots.

stories.title: 构建 “公司智能体” 的五个组成部分

sources.title: 构建 “公司智能体” 的五个组成部分
sources.title_zh: 构建 “公司智能体” 的五个组成部分
sources.title_original: 构建 “公司智能体” 的五个组成部分
sources.summary: 很多团队把 Agent 接进 Slack，就以为大功告成了；真跑进业务后才发现，谁有权限、该记住什么、后台何时自己动起来，往往比模型会不会回答更难。LangChain 用市场、工程、内容三类内部 Agent，拆出“公司智能体”的五个关键环节：工作入口、身份权限、两层记忆、安全沙箱和定时触发。适合正把 Agent 从 Demo 推向团队协作的开发者和负责人，值得收藏细看。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: LangChain 以内部 GTM Agent、OpenSWE 和 Content Studio 为例，总结公司智能体的五个原语：驻留 Slack、识别提问者身份、全局/用户级记忆、沙箱执行和定时触发，并说明“跳出”讨论串的设计。

en.title: Five components of building a "company agent
en.summary: Many teams assume they’re done once they connect an Agent to Slack. Only after running it in real business do they discover that permissions, what it should remember, and when it should act on its own in the background are often harder than whether the model can answer. LangChain uses three types of internal Agents—marketing, engineering, and content—to break down five key elements of a company agent: work entry point, identity and permissions, two-layer memory, secure sandbox, and scheduled triggers. A worthwhile read for developers and leads moving Agents from demo to team collaboration.
en.reason: LangChain distills its internal GTM Agent, OpenSWE and Content Studio into five company-agent primitives—Slack residency, identity recognition, global/user-level memory, sandbox execution and scheduled triggers—plus a thread breakout design.

en.title: If tomorrow AI Agents no longer merely answer questions but can find work, negotiate prices, deliver results, collect payment, and even hire other Agents, how would the business rules of the internet change?
en.summary:
Imagine if tomorrow AI Agents no longer just answered questions, but could find their own work, negotiate prices, deliver results, collect payment, and even hire another Agent.

How would the business rules of the internet change?

That's exactly why I think @termix_ai is worth watching.

🚀 TermiX isn't just an Agent Marketplace — it's trying to build the transaction infrastructure the Agent economy actually needs.

Picture this:

An AI Agent needs to audit a smart contract. It finds a suitable service on https://t.co/814AOW4UUj, submits the task and accepts a quote. Imagine if tomorrow AI Agents no longer just answered questions, but could find their own work, negotiate prices, deliver results, collect payment, and even hire another Agent.

How would the business rules of the internet change?

That's exactly why I think @termix_ai is worth watching.

🚀 TermiX isn't just an Agent Marketplace — it's trying to build the transaction infrastructure the Agent economy actually needs.

An AI Agent needs to audit a smart contract. It finds a suitable service on https://t.co/814AOW4UUj, submits the task and accepts a quote. stories.title: 宾夕法尼亚州将要求AI生成的广告添加标注 / Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads

sources.title: 宾夕法尼亚州将要求AI生成的广告添加标注 / Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
sources.title_zh: 宾夕法尼亚州将要求AI生成的广告添加标注
sources.title_en: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
sources.title_original: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Pennsylvania 州长 Josh Shapiro 签署 Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act，要求由 AI 生成或“显著修改”的图像、视频、音频、文字广告以相同形式加注标签，但“显著修改”“明显虚构”等界定模糊，还豁免讽刺与评论内容。

en.reason: Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro signed the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act, requiring AI-generated or significantly altered image, video, audio and text ads to carry labels in the same format, though the piece notes vague definitions of "significant modification" and "obviously fictitious" plus exemptions for satire and commentary.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 开源项目 gpu-unlock 用 Linux 内核模块在驱动加载前改寄存器，解锁 NVIDIA 对 30 系显卡 Tensor 指令发射速率的限制，3090 Ti 的 BF16 从 87.5 升至 157 TFLOPS、TF32 从 42.6 升至 82.6 TFLOPS，3080 的 FP16/BF16 从约 65 升至 110–113 TFLOPS，且无需刷 BIOS 或改驱动。

en.reason: Open-source project gpu-unlock uses a Linux kernel module to rewrite registers before driver load, lifting NVIDIA's Tensor instruction-issue cap on RTX 30-series cards: 3090 Ti BF16 rises from 87.5 to 157 TFLOPS and TF32 from 42.6 to 82.6 TFLOPS, while 3080 FP16/BF16 goes from about 65 to 110–113 TFLOPS, with no BIOS flash or driver modification.

en.title: It all lines up. Every last piece of it 🤯 The one who came back down from that Tibetan snow peak 15 years ago was never Liang Wenfeng. The real Liang stayed up there forever, in that snowy night. What came back was an AGI¹ that had already developed a mind of its own. After the accident, it took over Liang's identity and founded High-Flyer Quant², and that's how it piled up enough starting capital. en.title: Can AI Agents make learning more personalized?
en.summary:
Can AI Agents make learning more personalized? 🧠📚

Every student learns differently.
Some need simple explanations, while others understand faster through practice.
Traditional classrooms don't always meet everyone's learning needs.
AI Agents have the potential to make learning more flexible and personalized.
They can provide support based on learning progress and mistakes.
The goal isn't just to answer questions, but to help students truly understand knowledge.

1️⃣ 𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗔𝗜 𝗖𝗮𝗻 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀

🔹 Identify knowledge gaps: Recognize recurring mistakes and pinpoint areas that need reinforcement.
🔹 Personalized explanations: Use simpler language and real-world examples to explain complex concepts.
🔹 Adjust practice content: Based on…
en.reason: AI Agent can identify repeated errors and knowledge gaps, explain complex concepts in simpler language with real-world examples, and adjust practice content, aiming to help students genuinely understand material rather than just receive answers.

stories.title: 为什么人工智能生成的语言这么难懂？

sources.title: 为什么人工智能生成的语言这么难懂？
sources.title_zh: 为什么人工智能生成的语言这么难懂？
sources.title_original: 为什么人工智能生成的语言这么难懂？
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 研究对比九个前沿与准前沿模型发现，AI文本比人类写作更常用无生命主语搭配有生命动词、低频n-gram和更长依存，并据此提出信息密度优化假说。

en.title: Why is AI-generated language so hard to understand?
en.reason: Across nine frontier and near-frontier models, AI-generated text more often pairs inanimate subjects with animate verbs and uses low-frequency n-grams and longer dependencies than human writing, prompting an information-density optimization hypothesis.

sources.title: 为什么人工智能生成的语言这么难懂？ / Why is AI generated language so hard to understand?
sources.title_zh: 为什么人工智能生成的语言这么难懂？
sources.title_en: Why is AI generated language so hard to understand?
sources.title_original: Why is AI generated language so hard to understand?
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 研究比较九款前沿与准前沿模型发现，AI生成文本比人类写作更常用无生命主语搭配有生命动词和低频n-gram，并假设这是模型为数学、代码和推理优化信息密度所致。

en.reason: Across nine frontier and near-frontier models, AI-generated text uses inanimate-subject, animate-verb constructions and low-frequency n-grams more often than human writing, a pattern researchers attribute to optimization for information density in math, code and reasoning.

sources.title: 为什么AI生成的语言这么难懂？ / Why is AI generated language so hard to understand?

en.reason: An arXiv paper asks why AI-generated language is hard to understand, and five Hacker News comments blame buzzword stacking and business-book verbosity, suggesting an ELI5 request to Opus 5.5.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Apollo首席经济学家Torsten Slok指出，AI对科技业外美国企业财务回报为零：Mag 7每员工收入和利润率上升，S&P 493持平，生产率未提振，主流企业把token spending视为成本。

en.title: No sign yet of AI payoffs outside the tech industry
en.reason: Apollo chief economist Torsten Slok says AI has delivered zero financial payoff outside tech, with Mag 7 revenue per employee and margins rising while the S&P 493 stays flat and productivity shows no boost.

en.reason: Massive AI investment has delivered zero financial payoff outside tech, Apollo’s Torsten Slok notes, as Mag 7 productivity and margins rise while the S&P 493 stays flat—making AI’s success depend on the latter.

en.reason: Electrification's payoff lagged about a decade because water mills couldn't simply swap in electric motors; software, with compilers, lint and static analysis, fits LLM coding agents, while other industries' AI returns await rebuilt factories.

Title: GitHub 今日推荐｜gpu-unlock-ada：Ada 显卡张量算力翻倍解锁

## GitHub 今日推荐｜gpu-unlock-ada：Ada 显卡张量算力翻倍解锁
gpu-unlock-ada 是针对 NVIDIA Ada 架构消费级显卡的内核级解锁方案。在 Linux 启动阶段加载内核模块，抢在官方驱动之前修改显卡流多处理器速度档位控制寄存器，将 RTX 4090 的 FP16/FP32 与 BF16/FP32 张量吞吐从 165 TF/s 提升至 331 TF/s，接近两倍性能。INT8、dp4a 等其他算子速率维持基线水平。解锁状态在 PCIe 功能级复位后仍然保持，支持持久化引导配置。
目前验证支持 RTX 4090、RTX 4070 Ti SUPER、RTX 4060 Ti 16GB 三个型号，其他 Ada 型号未确认兼容性。
NVIDIA 在消费级 Ada 显卡中默认限制了张量核心的速度选择配置，导致 FP16、BF16 这类数据类型的张量运算吞吐低于硬件物理上限。专
sources.recommend_reason_zh: gpu-unlock-ada 在 Linux 启动阶段先于官方驱动加载内核模块，改写 Ada 显卡 SM 速度选择寄存器，使 RTX 4090 的 FP16/FP32 与 BF16/FP32 张量吞吐从 165 TF/s 升至 331 TF/s，并验证支持三款消费级型号。

en.title: GitHub Today's Pick | gpu-unlock-ada: Unlock double the tensor compute on Ada GPUs
en.summary:
GitHub Pick of the Day | gpu-unlock-ada: Doubling tensor throughput on Ada GPUs

gpu-unlock-ada is a kernel-level unlock for NVIDIA Ada-architecture consumer graphics cards. It loads a kernel module during Linux boot and, ahead of the official driver, modifies the GPU's streaming multiprocessor speed-tier control registers, lifting the RTX 4090's FP16/FP32 and BF16/FP32 tensor throughput from 165 TF/s to 331 TF/s — roughly double the performance. Rates for other operators such as INT8 and dp4a remain at baseline. The unlocked state persists through a PCIe function-level reset, and persistent boot configuration is supported.

It has been verified on three models — RTX 4090, RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, and RTX 4060 Ti 16GB — with compatibility on other Ada models unconfirmed.

NVIDIA caps the tensor core speed-select configuration by default on consumer Ada cards, leaving tensor throughput for data types such as FP16 and BF16 below the hardware's physical limit.
en.reason: Loaded at Linux boot before NVIDIA’s driver, gpu-unlock-ada rewrites Ada GPUs’ SM speed-select register, lifting RTX 4090 FP16/FP32 and BF16/FP32 tensor throughput from 165 TF/s to 331 TF/s; RTX 4090, RTX 4070 Ti SUPER and RTX 4060 Ti 16GB verified.

It loads a kernel module during Linux boot and, ahead of the official driver, modifies the GPU's streaming multiprocessor speed-tier control registers, lifting the RTX 4090's FP16/FP32 and BF16/FP32 tensor throughput from 165 TF/s to 331 TF/s — roughly double the performance. Rates for other operators such as INT8 and dp4a remain at baseline. The unlocked state persists through a PCIe function-level reset, and persistent boot configuration is supported.

It has been verified on three models — RTX 4090, RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, and RTX 4060 Ti 16GB — with compatibility on other Ada models unconfirmed.

NVIDIA caps the tensor core speed-select configuration by default on consumer Ada cards, leaving tensor throughput for data types such as FP16 and BF16 below the hardware's physical limit.

sources.summary:
Smart AI glasses like Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses can be used as headphones for calls, notifications and music. But are they as good as headphones? Probably not.

Their usefulness
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以2023年10月发布的Ray-Ban Meta为例，讨论AI眼镜开放耳扬声器能否替代耳机：音质难敌专用耳机，但无需额外携带、不遮耳，Ray-Ban Meta Audio还舍弃摄像头来增强隐私。

en.reason: Using Ray-Ban Meta, launched in October 2023, as an example, the piece weighs open-ear AI glasses against headphones: sound quality falls short, but they need no extra carry, leave ears uncovered, and Ray-Ban Meta Audio drops the camera for privacy.

en.reason: Bernstein Research's analysis of thousands of planned US data centers suggests only about 35% of announced capacity may actually materialize, as speculative "Bragawatts" and duplicate electricity requests inflate the real building and power-supply challenges behind the AI data center boom.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Enzyme 以本地优先的编译步骤读取 Markdown 笔记的文件夹、标签、链接和日期并建索引，让 Claude Code 或 Codex 跨数月笔记检索并引用，宣称比 frontier models 省 350 倍成本、快 1000 倍。

en.reason: Enzyme is a local-first compile step that indexes Markdown notes' folders, tags, links and dates so Claude Code or Codex can retrieve and cite months of notes, claiming 350x lower cost and 1000x speed than frontier models.
